summary: Indicator positioned on the corner of an element (Avatar, IconButton, icon): an Intl-formatted count with “99+” overflow, or a status dot, with dedicated accessible text.
whenToUse: Unread notifications or messages on a top-bar IconButton.
Presence status (online) or something new on an avatar.
Count of new replies on a navigation icon.
whenNotToUse: Inline labels or counts in text, next to tabs or menu items: use Badge.
Release stage of a feature or site: use StageLabel.
Labels on the corner of cards or images: use Ribbon.

props.name: children
props.description: Element the indicator is anchored to.

props.name: count
props.description: Number shown; above max it becomes “max+”.

props.name: dot
props.description: Dot without a number (takes precedence over count).

props.name: tone
props.description: Color; brand uses the accent gradient.

props.name: showZero
props.description: Shows the indicator even when count is 0.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible text (e.g. “3 unread notifications”), visually hidden; the bubble becomes aria-hidden.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Pulsing halo to draw attention; disabled with prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: overlap
props.description: circular moves the indicator closer to the edge of round elements (avatars).

accessibility: Without label only the number is read (“3”): always pass a label with context (“3 unread notifications”).

With label the bubble is aria-hidden and the text sits in a VisuallyHidden right after the child: it is not part of the accessible name of a child IconButton. If it is needed in the name, include the count in the IconButton label too.
The dot without label is not announced: add a label when it conveys information (“Online”).
When the indicator is hidden (count 0 without showZero) the label is not rendered either.
Count updates are not announced automatically: use a live region (Toast or VisuallyHidden role="status") if needed.
In forced-colors the bubble has a system border and the dot uses the Mark color; pulse is disabled.
responsive: The indicator is absolutely positioned on the child and does not affect the surrounding layout.
The bubble widens with the number of digits (“99+”).
customization: Tokens: --dc-color-action-danger (default), --dc-gradient-accent (brand), feedback colors and --dc-color-surface-inverse, --dc-color-surface-default for the separation ring.
commonMistakes: Omitting label: the screen reader reads a number with no context.
Using pulse permanently: reserve it for recent news.
Placing the indicator inside an element with hidden overflow: it gets clipped.
